---
title: "LIQPLAT CONSORT-style participant accounting"
date: 2026-08-20
format:
  html:
    toc: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Participant accounting follows the trial's screening and random-selection
definitions. Assignment to the invitation strategy is retained for ITT
accounting; acceptance is summarized only when an approved acceptance field is
present and is never inferred from a missing value.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

source(here::here("analysis", "_module-common.R"), local = FALSE)
liqplat_source_public_helpers()
config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- module_force()
stage_id <- "population_consort"
result_dir <- module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "01-population"))
checkpoint_path <- module_checkpoint_path(stage_id)
consort_path <- file.path(result_dir, "consort-accounting.parquet")
figure_path <- file.path(result_dir, "consort-accounting.svg")
input_path <- file.path(module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "00-data")),
                        "analysis-cohort.parquet")
recruitment_input_path <- file.path(
  module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "00-data")),
  "analysis-recruitment.parquet"
)
if (!file.exists(input_path) || !file.exists(recruitment_input_path)) {
  stop("CONSORT accounting requires the built analysis cohort and recruitment Parquet.")
}
input_paths <- c(input_path, recruitment_input_path)
output_paths <- c(consort_path, figure_path)
decision <- checkpoint_decision(
  checkpoint_path, stage_id, input_paths = input_paths,
  output_paths = output_paths,
  code_paths = here::here("analysis", "01-population", "02-consort.qmd"),
  config = config, force = force
)

if (identical(decision, "skip")) {
  consort_accounting <- read_result_table(consort_path)
} else {
  recruitment_raw <- read_result_table(recruitment_input_path)
  require_public_columns(recruitment_raw, c("id", "screened_date", "eligible"),
                         "CONSORT recruitment accounting")
  recruitment_raw$screened_date <- parse_analysis_date(
    recruitment_raw$screened_date, "screened_date", allow_missing = FALSE
  )
  recruitment_raw$eligible <- validate_binary(
    recruitment_raw$eligible, "eligible", allow_missing = FALSE
  )
  if ("randomization_date" %in% names(recruitment_raw)) {
    recruitment_raw$randomization_date <- parse_analysis_date(
      recruitment_raw$randomization_date, "randomization_date"
    )
  }
  if ("tx" %in% names(recruitment_raw)) {
    recruitment_raw$tx <- validate_binary(recruitment_raw$tx, "tx")
  }
  id_groups <- split(seq_len(nrow(recruitment_raw)),
                     as.character(recruitment_raw$id), drop = TRUE)
  recruitment_rows <- lapply(id_groups, function(index) {
    part <- recruitment_raw[index, , drop = FALSE]
    result <- data.frame(
      id = as.character(part$id[[1L]]),
      screened_date = min(part$screened_date, na.rm = TRUE),
      eligible = as.integer(max(part$eligible, na.rm = TRUE)),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    if ("randomization_date" %in% names(part)) {
      values <- part$randomization_date[!is.na(part$randomization_date)]
      result$randomization_date <- if (length(values) == 0L) as.Date(NA) else min(values)
    }
    if ("tx" %in% names(part)) {
      values <- unique(part$tx[!is.na(part$tx)])
      if (length(values) > 1L) stop("Conflicting recruitment assignment for patient.")
      result$tx <- if (length(values) == 0L) NA_integer_ else as.integer(values[[1L]])
    }
    result
  })
  recruitment <- do.call(rbind, recruitment_rows)
  rownames(recruitment) <- NULL
  eligible <- validate_binary(recruitment$eligible, "eligible", allow_missing = FALSE)
  randomized <- if ("randomization_date" %in% names(recruitment)) {
    !is.na(parse_analysis_date(recruitment$randomization_date, "randomization_date"))
  } else {
    rep(FALSE, nrow(recruitment))
  }
  assignment <- if ("tx" %in% names(recruitment)) validate_binary(recruitment$tx, "tx") else
    rep(NA_real_, nrow(recruitment))
  offered_col <- intersect(c("invitation_offered", "offered_invitation"),
                           names(recruitment_raw))[1L]
  accepted_col <- intersect(c("invitation_accepted", "accepted_invitation"),
                            names(recruitment_raw))[1L]
  if (is.na(offered_col)) {
    offered <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(recruitment))
  } else {
    raw_offered <- validate_binary(recruitment_raw[[offered_col]], offered_col)
    offered_by_id <- tapply(raw_offered, recruitment_raw$id,
                            function(value) if (all(is.na(value))) NA_real_ else
                              as.numeric(any(value == 1, na.rm = TRUE)))
    offered <- unname(offered_by_id[recruitment$id])
  }
  if (is.na(accepted_col)) {
    accepted <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(recruitment))
  } else {
    raw_accepted <- validate_binary(recruitment_raw[[accepted_col]], accepted_col)
    accepted_by_id <- tapply(raw_accepted, recruitment_raw$id,
                             function(value) if (all(is.na(value))) NA_real_ else
                               as.numeric(any(value == 1, na.rm = TRUE)))
    accepted <- unname(accepted_by_id[recruitment$id])
  }
  consort_accounting <- data.frame(
    step = c(
      "screened",
      "eligible",
      "screened_out",
      "random_selection_recorded",
      "selected_for_invitation",
      "not_selected",
      "invitation_offered",
      "invitation_accepted"
    ),
    n = c(
      nrow(recruitment),
      sum(eligible == 1),
      sum(eligible == 0),
      sum(randomized),
      sum(randomized & assignment == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(randomized & assignment == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(offered == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(accepted == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    denominator = c(
      nrow(recruitment), nrow(recruitment), nrow(recruitment),
      sum(eligible == 1), sum(eligible == 1), sum(eligible == 1),
      sum(offered == 1, na.rm = TRUE), sum(offered == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    status = c(
      rep("observed", 6),
      if (is.na(offered_col)) "pending_field" else "observed",
      if (is.na(accepted_col)) "pending_field" else "observed"
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  consort_accounting$proportion <- with(
    consort_accounting,
    ifelse(denominator > 0, n / denominator, NA_real_)
  )
  write_module_table(consort_accounting, consort_path)
  if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'ggplot2' is required for the CONSORT accounting figure.")
  }
  plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    consort_accounting[consort_accounting$step %in% c("screened", "eligible",
                                                       "screened_out", "selected_for_invitation",
                                                       "not_selected"), , drop = FALSE],
    ggplot2::aes(x = stats::reorder(step, n), y = n)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_col() +
    ggplot2::coord_flip() +
    ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Patients") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal()
  assert_artifact_path(figure_path)
  ggplot2::ggsave(figure_path, plot = plot, width = 8, height = 4, units = "in")
  finalize_module_checkpoint(
    stage_id = stage_id,
    checkpoint_path = checkpoint_path,
    input_paths = input_paths,
    output_paths = output_paths,
    config = config,
    metadata = list(data_lock = config_get(config, "analysis", "data_lock"),
                    status = "built"),
    code_paths = here::here("analysis", "01-population", "02-consort.qmd")
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: consort-table
#| tbl-cap: "Aggregate CONSORT-style accounting"

consort_accounting |>
  transform(proportion = round(proportion, 4)) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
